claims.claim: Dubai Metro's Red Line reopened on Monday after maintenance work.
claims.label: unverified
claims.explanation: The RTA stated the Red Line resumed full service on Monday after maintenance was completed [1]. Passengers returned to the Red Line on Monday morning with trains running on the normal timetable again [2].

claims.claim: افتتحت هيئة الطرق والمواصلات في دبي محطة مترو جديدة على الخط الأحمر.
claims.label: supported
claims.explanation: هيئة الطرق والمواصلات في دبي أعلنت افتتاح محطة جديدة على الخط الأحمر [1]. المحطة بدأت تستقبل الركاب صباح اليوم [2].

claims.claim: All schools in Abu Dhabi will close for a month because of heavy rain.
claims.label: contradicted
claims.explanation: The claim is contradicted because schools in Abu Dhabi will only switch to remote learning for one day due to rain, not a full month [1]. Classes are expected to resume normally by Wednesday [2].

claims.claim: metro dubai أوقف all lines today بسبب heavy flooding in the city
claims.label: contradicted
claims.explanation: الCLAIM خاطئ لأن المترو يعمل بشكل طبيعي اليوم وفقًا للتأكيد من RTA [1].

claims.claim: A new species of falcon was discovered in the Hajar Mountains last week.
claims.label: unverified
claims.explanation: The evidence mentions that the Hajar Mountains are a popular hiking destination, but this does not confirm or deny the discovery of a new falcon species [1]. The mention of falconry as a traditional sport in the UAE does not provide information about a new species discovery [2].

claims.claim: ستطلق الإمارات رحلة مأهولة إلى المريخ العام المقبل.
claims.label: unverified
claims.explanation: البيانات لا تؤكد أو تنفي Claim، لأنها تتحدث عن زيارة سياح إلى دبي [1] وافتتاح متحف في الشارقة [2].
